scripts.dev: npm run db:up && (npm run dev -w api & npm run dev -w web & wait)
scripts.check: npm run check -w api && npm run check -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test -w web
scripts.e2e:servidor: npm run build && rm -rf api/public && cp -r web/dist api/public && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --env-file=.env.test api/src/index.ts
